subject.title: amazon-bedrock provider: Haiku 4.5 inference profile ARN not supported; params.modelId override ignored

question: Which Bedrock request identity contract should OpenClaw support for configured models that need inference profiles or ARNs?
rationale: The remaining fix is not a local typo: maintainers must decide whether AWS request identity lives only in the provider model id/discovery catalog or whether `params.modelId` becomes a Bedrock-specific override contract.

options.title: Use discovered profile ids
options.body: Keep AWS request identity in the provider model id, document exact discovered profile IDs or explicitly registered full profile refs, and repair Haiku 4.5 through the Bedrock plugin discovery/runtime path.

options.title: Adopt `params.modelId` override
options.body: Make `agents.defaults.models[...].params.modelId` an explicit Bedrock-only request identity override with schema/docs/tests and upgrade guidance.

options.title: Add narrow alias mapping
options.body: Map the reporter's short Haiku 4.5 alias to the current inference profile id, but avoid a general override contract.

recommendation.title: Use discovered profile ids
recommendation.body: Keep AWS request identity in the provider model id, document exact discovered profile IDs or explicitly registered full profile refs, and repair Haiku 4.5 through the Bedrock plugin discovery/runtime path.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the inference-profile discovery contract introduced in PR #61299.
